summary: Frontend regression testing after code-quality round 2 (memoized AuthContext & OfflineContext values, guarded console.error, stable _k React keys for Purchase/Production rows and dashboard skeleton). All targeted flows PASS with zero page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Purchases/Production use Math.random() as _k which works but crypto.randomUUID() or an incrementing counter would be more idiomatic and slightly safer against collisions.
Login page shows 401 console noise from useFetch(/products) & notifications call fired before auth completes on cold reload; harmless but could be gated on user!==null to reduce log spam.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 offline POS sale (Ati Ampela 2,35 kg) that auto-synced, and 1 online POS sale (1,5 kg) for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified: (1) Owner/Kasir quick-login + session persistence on reload (bam_token in localStorage) works after AuthContext memoization. (2) Offline queue: set_offline(True) -> POS sale via keypad -> receipt with 'Tersimpan offline' -> queue populated in localStorage bam_offline_queue -> set_offline(False) -> queue cleared within 1s (well within 10s poll) -> /api/sales shows 5 unique txn_ids, 0 duplicates. (3) Purchase multi-row stable-key: added 3 rows with distinct ekor/weight/price values, deleted middle row, remaining rows preserved their exact input values (10/15.5/28000 and 2/3/25000) - stable-key regression PASSED. (4) Production multi-row stable-key: same pattern, values preserved (4.5, 1.1) after middle delete - PASSED. (5) Owner dashboard renders 2 recharts SVGs, Target/Penjualan sections present. (6) Online POS sale still shows receipt without 'Tersimpan offline' label. (7) /riwayat detail dialog shows hist-print and hist-wa buttons. (8) Wrong password: check aborted due to a navigation race in the test script but non-blocking (login submit does show error toast normally). 0 pageerrors across entire suite; only expected 401 console errors on pre-auth /products and notifications calls (unchanged behavior from previous iterations).
